digest.component_or_area: completion verifier wrapper and close instrumentation
propositions: 237743.4 ms of the 423502 ms verifier_call_ms interval remains unattributed after subtracting inner workflow timings (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms), requiring direct phase instrumentation to identify ownership.

Direct monotonic timers must partition the close wrapper through attempt, handle resolution, snapshot context, inner setup, dispatch, and finalization layers to close the attribution gap without adding I/O, subprocesses, network calls, or traversals.

Hierarchical direct phase timings must reconcile to verifier_call_ms with maximum 1 ms discrepancy per summed phase (10 ms cap total), with any larger remainder explicitly labeled unattributed_verifier_ms and not assigned causal operation names.

Existing inner metrics (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms) and workload counts (requests, tool_calls, attempt/resume/drain rounds) must remain unchanged and be measured during existing traversals without extra work.
Model-backed PASS and FAIL sidecars must directly report the partitioned wrapper phases with verifier_call_ms fully reconciled across both verdict outcomes.
Instrumentation overhead must remain under 50 microseconds per close and add no optional-collector runtime work when no collector is supplied.
